In this mind-blowing experiment, I placed firecrackers inside a balloon, tied it up, and submerged it in water. After pulling it out, I cut the balloon's opening and lit the firecrackers. Surprisingly, the firecrackers didn't get wet and ignited perfectly! Watch this fascinating science experiment to see how fire and water interact in the most unexpected way.
